title: Prepare test-run evidence persistence off StateInner using immutable cuts and owner-generation fences
outcome: Test-run lifecycle, receipt, association and evidence-publication selection uses maintained derived indexes to avoid full retained-history scans under StateInner, preserving existing evidence and publication semantics; measurements determine whether off-lock immutable cuts are still needed.
acceptance: Lifecycle revalidation, receipt settlement, check association and evidence-batch publication use maintained candidate indexes instead of full live or compacted history scans under StateInner. Original matching predicates, multiplicity and first-match ordering remain authoritative. Indexes are rebuilt on load and maintained incrementally at every relevant mutation, replacement, compaction transfer and rollback, with a test-only full-scan consistency oracle.

Existing evidence semantics, authority and binding checks, exact durability fences, compacted proof and durability flags, receipt input order, delta revisions and first-match projection equivalence are preserved. Deterministic regression coverage exercises these semantics plus index maintenance, restart/load reconstruction and persistence failure/rollback.

Deterministic witnesses account for production-path candidate visits, nested association work and index maintenance, showing no growth from history outside the queried index buckets; same-bucket distractors and large matching rows are measured separately. Record comparable baseline-versus-repaired StateInner hold measurements on controlled retained-history fixtures, with counts, payload sizes and exclusion of test-only oracle overhead disclosed. Live/canary measurements may supplement this evidence but are not required to schedule the controlled measurement. Report remaining clone, fallback-persistence or hot-bucket cost and whether a follow-up is needed; do not infer a total latency bound from row counts alone.
The required independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher findings, and the full gate passes on the exact input that is landed.
